current.name: Calibration Engine
current.changes: Fundamental strategy shift. Instead of LLM estimation, apply statistical calibration correction from 6,264 resolved questions. Crowd systematically overestimates probability in 20-50% range. Buy NO on overconfident markets, sell when market corrects or hold to resolution. Capital rotation: sell winning positions early, redeploy. Edge decay monitoring built in. 87% simulated win rate, zero API cost.

changelog.name: Genesis
changelog.changes: Initial scaffolding. Paper trading on Manifold. Basic scanner + estimator.

changelog.name: Deep Research
changelog.changes: DuckDuckGo news search, Claude Haiku quality filter, category-specific data (yfinance, polls).

changelog.name: Learning Loop
changelog.changes: Resolution checker, learning system, duplicate detection, concurrent processing, robust JSON parsing.

changelog.name: Tiered Exposure
changelog.changes: Backtest-calibrated position sizing. 5 edge tiers from backtest data (100 markets, Brier 0.22). Sweet spot at 5-20% edge, reduced exposure on 20%+ overconfidence zone.

changelog.name: Agreement Filter
changelog.changes: Critical discovery: only trade when bot and market agree on direction. 94% win rate (agree) vs 21% (disagree) across 100 backtest markets. Bot's edge is in magnitude, not direction. Skip high-edge disagreement trades where market is right 79% of the time. Sweet spot confirmed: 5-20% edge + agreement = 97% win rate.
